mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below its 3-year moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining GDPC1 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals accelerating supply-side momentum, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profit margins expand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising FEDFUNDS above 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
